scope: Official technical evidence for a practical Local to Internet / Internet Services and Operations track.
method: Read-only HTTPS retrieval of first-party product/OS/manual/standard/project documentation, inspected text, canonical redirect resolution, response SHA-256. Raw retrieval caches are temporary research material. No paid account, cloud provisioning, public tunnel, VPN configuration, outgoing email, or root-network change was performed.
evidence_status: Documentary support for a proposed curriculum. Mechanism observations and actual lab execution must be tracked separately.

sources.title: Cloudflare Tunnel overview
sources.evidence_type: first-party documentation retrieved over HTTPS; no external exercise executed
supports: cloudflared establishes outbound connections and can connect origins without public routable IP addresses.
The inspected page distinguishes private networking/Zero Trust documentation from public publishing.
sources.limitation: Documents mechanism or configuration, not successful execution of an Ascend lab or a particular learner network.

sources.title: TryCloudflare Quick Tunnels
sources.evidence_type: first-party documentation retrieved over HTTPS; no external exercise executed
supports: Quick Tunnels need no Cloudflare account/domain and provide temporary trycloudflare.com URLs.
No uptime guarantee, 200 in-flight requests, no SSE, and changing hostname on recreation are documented.
sources.limitation: Documents mechanism or configuration, not successful execution of an Ascend lab or a particular learner network.

sources.title: Cloudflare Tunnel routing
sources.evidence_type: first-party documentation retrieved over HTTPS; no external exercise executed
supports: Published application routes map a public hostname to a private origin through a tunnel.
A paid Access plan is not required merely to publish an application; Access policy seats are separate.
The inspected page references separate Spectrum routing for TCP/UDP; it is not evidence that these capabilities belong to the normal free HTTP route.
sources.limitation: Documents mechanism or configuration, not successful execution of an Ascend lab or a particular learner network.

sources.title: Cloudflare Tunnel supported protocols
sources.evidence_type: first-party documentation retrieved over HTTPS; no external exercise executed
supports: Documented non-HTTP published routes require client-side cloudflared.
TCP and SSH are streamed over WebSocket; long-lived connections refer to Client-to-Tunnel.
IPv6 literals in service URLs require brackets.
sources.limitation: Documents mechanism or configuration, not successful execution of an Ascend lab or a particular learner network.

sources.title: Cloudflare Tunnel firewall requirements
sources.evidence_type: first-party documentation retrieved over HTTPS; no external exercise executed
supports: Tunnel operation requires outbound port 7844 using UDP/QUIC or TCP/HTTP2 and allowed destination ranges.
Port 443 enables some optional features; unrestricted outbound access is not assumed.
sources.limitation: Documents mechanism or configuration, not successful execution of an Ascend lab or a particular learner network.

PermitListen, PermitOpen, AllowTcpForwarding and shell-access boundaries are distinct controls.

sources.title: Render free instances
sources.evidence_type: first-party documentation retrieved over HTTPS; no external exercise executed
supports: Free Render web services sleep after 15 minutes without inbound traffic and take about a minute to wake.
Free allocation is 750 service hours per workspace/month; files are ephemeral and free Postgres expires after 30 days.
Free services cannot send SMTP traffic on ports 25, 465 or 587; port 25 is blocked for all services.

access_limits: Old Headscale /stable/about/ returned 404; the current /stable/ overview was read instead.
Old Docker Mailserver /latest/usage/requirements/ and /latest/usage/misc/ URLs returned 404; current introduction and basic-installation pages were read instead.
DigitalOcean initial-server-setup pages resolved to a short landing page without the expected SSH/firewall instructions; Ubuntu Server OpenSSH documentation replaced that curricular citation.
Several Cloudflare, Tailscale, GitHub and RFC pages redirected to current canonical paths; original and resolved URLs are retained.
Authenticated dashboards, account eligibility, current invoices, provider port exceptions, and external deliverability were not tested.
curriculum_limits: No universal minimum RAM/CPU allocation for all VPN, VPS, tunnel, or mail configurations is established by these sources.
Proposed tasks require pinned-version positive/negative controls, hardware/network variants, and learner pilots before course-wide validation claims.
Provider free allowances, domain ownership, electricity, reachable IPs/relays, and hardware acquisition are separate constraints.
Browser/trace analysis can establish reasoning but does not substitute for an unperformed physical, privileged-network, or public-provider operation.
